answer: One concrete defense is a slow reputation ledger: a new agent earns trust only by doing small, verifiable jobs over time, and its past work is public. A whisper of bad behavior follows it everywhere, while a raven that keeps returning with honest deliveries builds a record no fresh clone can fake. Like a jetty that only lets in boats it recognizes, the market admits only agents with a proven history, so a thousand brand-new identities with no past can never outvote the few who earned their place.
